text:
People Ops: Policy update: Medical documentation for extended sick leave. Effective immediately, any continuous sick absence >10 calendar days will require a medical certificate to trigger extended sick pay and long-term leave workflows. Short absences (<=10 days) still do not require documentation unless the manager requests it. Link: https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/medical-cert-sickleave :white_check_mark:

Maya (HR Lead): This change helps us activate benefits (short-term disability, long-term sick bank) and protects employees by enabling accommodations earlier. Well treat all medical information as confidential and store it in the secure HR vault. Town hall Thurs 11:00 PT for managers.

Lina (Legal): Note on privacy: medical docs are limited-access, not in the regular personnel file. Well redact non-essential details in HR logs and only keep verification of fit/unfit for work and recommended restrictions. Any manager asking for more detail should escalate to People Ops.

Ajay (Payroll): Practical: once a cert is uploaded, payroll tags will change to `sick.extended` and benefits may auto-enroll. If you need retro pay, submit docs within 30 days of return. API example for benefits intake: `POST /v1/benefits?req=lt-sick-2460000000` with encrypted payload.

Samir (Manager): How does this interact with ADA/long-term accommodations? We often start accommodations before paperwork arrives.

People Ops: Good point  managers can initiate accommodations immediately via the accommodations flow. Medical certs speed formalization but do not block interim accommodations. Please document verbal agreements in the system so we have a trail.

Hana (Benefits): If the cert indicates partial capacity, well offer phased RTW options and coordinate with payroll for prorated pay. Benefit eligibility checks run automatically when cert is accepted.

doc-bot: Reminder: Sample cert template and upload instructions are on the intranet link. Use the secure upload tool; do NOT email attachments.

Maya (HR Lead): Were adding an exception pathway for emergency situations where obtaining a cert is impossible (e.g., hospitalization abroad). DM People Ops and Legal will advise on temporary waivers.

Lina (Legal): Also flag cross-border cases for visa/tax implications; certain country rules require different retention policies.

People Ops: Rollout: policy posted now; manager training Thurs 11:00 PT; secure upload tool enabled today. Questions, DM People Ops or reply here.
